Lifecycle Phase 04 of 10

AI/App Development

Implementation of the approved design.

Overview

The Development phase implements the approved design. Hardened Build LLC applies secure coding practices, enforced version control, and peer review from the first commit. Authentication, authorization, and data protection controls are implemented as foundational properties of the system rather than as subsequent additions.

Activities and Deliverables

  • Implementation of the solution in accordance with the approved design.
  • Secure coding practices enforced throughout the development process.
  • Version control with mandatory peer code review prior to integration.
  • Automated unit and integration testing developed alongside the implementation.
  • Continuous integration, with each change merged, verified, and deployed to a testable endpoint.

Phase Specifics

  • Secure coding practices applied throughout
  • Version control and peer code review
  • Automated testing during development
  • Continuous integration of changes

Engagement

This phase is available as part of a complete lifecycle engagement or as a discrete service.
